description: Schedule, publish and analyze social media posts across multiple channels with Buffer.

auth.description:
**How to get your Buffer access token:**

1. Sign in to Buffer at https://buffer.com and open the [Developer Apps](https://publish.buffer.com/developers/apps) page.
2. Click **Create New App** and fill in the basic details (callback URL can be any placeholder).
3. After the app is created, copy the **Access Token** shown on the app's page.
4. Paste it below.

The token is sent as a Bearer token to the Buffer GraphQL API (https://api.buffer.com).

aiMetadata.description: Creates a social media post in Buffer for one or more channels, where the share mode controls timing: add to the channel queue, share next (skip the queue), share now, or schedule for a custom time. Choose it to draft or publish content to connected social accounts. A custom-scheduled post requires the scheduled time; posting to multiple channels creates a separate post per channel. Not idempotent — each call creates new posts.

nl.\n**How to get your Buffer access token::
**Hoe krijg je je Buffer access token:**

1. Log in bij Buffer op https://buffer.com en open de [Developer Apps](https://publish.buffer.com/developers/apps) pagina.
2. Klik op **Creëer nieuwe app** en vul de algemene details in (callback URL kan een placeholder zijn).

Het token wordt als een Bearer token verzonden naar de Buffer GraphQL API (https://api.buffer.com).

pt.\n**How to get your Buffer access token::
**Como obter seu token de acesso ao Buffer :**

1. Entre no Buffer em https://buffer.com e abra a página [Developer Apps](https://publish.buffer.com/developers/apps).
2. Clique em **Criar novo aplicativo** e preencha os detalhes básicos (o URL de retorno pode ser qualquer espaço reservado).
3. Depois que o aplicativo é criado, copie o **Token de Acesso** mostrado na página do aplicativo.
